title: Eleanor’s Reel
author: Bill Olson
problems: Row 2 "1st neighbors pull by right on right diagonal" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0's neighbor is outside the group.
Row 4 "2nd neighbors pull by left on left diagonal" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the left diagonal.
Row 2 "1st neighbors pull by right on right diagonal" can't start from where the dancers are: No "neighbor" pairs to dance with.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
